g.text: Hatch is one column wide: only column 6 is reachable —
CS and regular columns are never exposed together.
Turret cannot move while the hatch is open (ERR HATCH_OPEN).
the stack rests on the flush
Auth: the host checks the login (CS: 2FA + witness) before
UNLOCK; the device never decides auth.
Sequence numbers (41–44) are illustrative; 43 WEIGH repeats
once per vial with a new <seq>.
Fig 12 — Sequence: restocking one column (CS isolation by position)
Column 6 (midazolam, CS) is turned under the one-column hatch; each vial is tapped and weighed in; the host reconciles the count.
